workflowRecommendation: Single implementer, TDD per task in plan order T1-T8; one PR; tester runs smoke checkpoint 4 on the rig from this branch plus checkpoints.test.sh negative case; reviewer checks docs text against the plan's T7 wording.
concerns: Decision 1: ownership predicate liveAncestorTree treats queued/active/dead/launch-failed ancestors as owning; only lingering/closed make an orphan (sharpens spec Errors rows; same predicate in reducer and boot repair).

Decision 2: boot repair is ProcessManager.adoptQueuedChildTrees() called from index.ts before enableLaunches(); child-adopted publishes from index.ts after replayHeldRecoveries() via deps.envoyPublish (gate-off precedent), because ProcessManager has no envoyPublish dep.
Decision 3: skill gains a child-status row and a catchup-overseer clause in addition to the spec's child-adopted row, so the human-moved-to-todo Errors row and the boot 404 case are actionable.
writeStatus never updates local status on success: a second spawn_worker before the Dispatch echo writes in_progress again (idempotent; same window the corrective-implementer write accepts).
A launch-failed child tree (none live) still shadows the parent's spawn_worker via rootForIssue until the controller re-admits it; out of Design scope (queued trees only).
tasks: T2 reducers.ts admitOnTodo / reduceIssueClosed own-tree linger / exported childAdopted; reducers.test A1, A2b, A4b
T3 workers.ts spawnStatus architect->in_progress from todo; api.test A7a-c and stale comment at :2432
T4 processes.test A3 sub-architect spawn env + A3-negative legacy child tree
T5 processes.ts adoptQueuedChildTrees + index.ts call/publish + issues.ts publish helper generalized; index.test A4/A5, A4-orphan, idempotence
T6 smoke checkpoints.sh checkpoint_four rewrite, checkpoints.test.sh fixture + negative case, README row 4

T7 docs: daemon AGENTS.md (/worker/spawn row, /phase/complete row, new admission bullet, boot ordering, files table) and skills/legion-architect/SKILL.md (section 2 paragraph, child-adopted + child-status rows, catchup-overseer clause)
T8 targeted verification: bun test on the four test files, tsc, biome on touched files, bash scripts/smoke/checkpoints.test.sh

acceptanceMap.4: T2.2, T5; index.test A4/A5 + reducers.test A4b
acceptanceMap.8: T6; checkpoints.test.sh + tester's rig run of checkpoint 4

testerSurface: Smoke rig SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=envoy from this branch; checkpoint 4 after the root architect releases and spawns the child's sub-architect; negative controls: checkpoints.test.sh failing fixture and checkpoint 4 before release; boot-repair check by giving the child a queued tree in state.json and restarting the rig daemon.
